ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded - Deepcaller
ModMetaData.author: Nidelese
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Deepcaller psycaster path to Vanilla Psycasts Expanded.
Call writhing tentacles up from beneath the rimworld's crust to guard your home. Tentacles lash and grapple intruders, feed on the fallen, and evolve — from Sprout to Grasper to Crusher to Colossus. Raise an Idol of the Deep and keep it fed, and your summons will rise stronger from the very first cast.
An area-defense summoner path: control the ground, choose what gets close, and make them regret it.
